title: nan
authors: Almalis N.D.; Tsihrintzis G.A.; Mitsios M.; Tilemachos T.
key_contribution: Presents a decentralized reinforcement learning (DRL) framework fusing RGB, thermal, and depth data with PPO for real-time UAV target tracking and navigation in GNSS-denied terrain.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
